tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: Board palette. Primary brand colour. Logo ink on light grounds, primary action fill in light. Never as text below 14px on muted grounds.

tokens.name: graphite-ink
tokens.usage: Board palette. Text colour and core UI in light. Reached through `ink`, not directly.

tokens.name: warm-grey
tokens.usage: Board palette. Secondary text in light. Reached through `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: porcelain
tokens.usage: Board palette. Main background in light; wordmark ink on espresso and on dark grounds.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Board palette. Cards and raised surfaces in light. Reached through `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Board palette. Dividers and borders. Reached through `line`. Decorative only; 1.4:1 on white, so never the only border on a control.

tokens.name: deep-emerald
tokens.usage: Board palette. Gains, positive returns, success. Reached through `positive`.

tokens.name: muted-crimson
tokens.usage: Board palette. Losses, negative returns, alerts. Reached through `negative`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (app shell, marketing pages).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, trade ticket, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Segmented controls, selected range tab, table header rows, pending and neutral chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative; pair with `line-strong` on controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, chart axes. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-muted` and every soft tint. 12:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, timestamps on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-muted` and soft tints (4.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected nav marker, active toggle. One per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` and `action-hover`.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Brand tint behind Testnet, Mock and Forward-tested tags, and the selected nav item.

tokens.name: on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, positive change, confirmed transactions. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `positive-soft`. Always paired with a + sign or up arrow.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background for positive change chips and positive market-state cards.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, negative change, failed transactions, risk-limit breaches. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `negative-soft`. Always paired with a minus sign or down arrow.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background for negative change chips, alerts and the High volatility flag.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: Ink for the wordmark when it must be drawn inline (SVG path with fill). Prefer the logo files, which already carry the right ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset, every interactive element. 10:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: alloc-1
tokens.usage: Allocation and composition charts, first holding.

tokens.name: alloc-2
tokens.usage: Allocation charts, second holding.

tokens.name: alloc-3
tokens.usage: Allocation charts, third holding. Below 3:1 on white, so segments always carry a text label.

tokens.name: alloc-cash
tokens.usage: Idle cash and the empty track in allocation bars. Decorative, always labelled.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. One per page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline money values (portfolio value, order total). Tabular figures on.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase tracked label above a title or section. Set in caps in the source text or with text-transform.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Build, test, and execute your own investment strategies.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rebalance whenever a position drifts more than 5 pt.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chips, table headers, tabs.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Prices, amounts and percentages in rows and tables. Tabular figures on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Asset row and table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, tags, range tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, menus, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, the trade ticket.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only (primary and secondary CTAs). Never on chips or tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, always together with a `line` border.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the approval sheet.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs in tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary CTA on marketing and trade submit.
